examples.title: Simulated rigid parts: seven listed parts and a stranger
examples.contents: 7 listed parts, 1 part not on the list, 1 small washer
examples.what: A simulated bin with rigid parts made from part drawings (synthetic test parts): L block with holes, L block with holes (mirror), L sheet bracket, mouse (freeform), pocket block B, stepped shaft, tube with sleeves. A T-profile that is not on the job list lies among them, and a small M8 washer. The job list also named a part that was not in the bin: S rod (solid). Six views, SAM segmentation.
examples.result: All 7 listed parts found with the right type and pose (MSSD 0.9-2.0 mm, limit 5.0 mm here). The T-profile was not reported as a listed part, the absent part was not reported, and the washer was counted (1 of 1).
examples.check: Compared with the simulation truth. A listed part counts as correct when its type is right and its surface error MSSD (the largest distance between matching surface points of the found and the true part, taking the part's symmetry into account) is at most max(min(10 % of the part's size, 5 mm), 2 mm). A part that is not on the list must not be reported as a listed part. Small flat parts such as the washer are only counted. Development scene: the segmentation settings were tuned on it. Shown is the run of 2026-10-11; a later version of the code gives the same poses (checked: largest difference 0.00 mm, 0.000 degrees).

rigid.criterion: Correct = type correct and MSSD <= max(min(0.1 d, 5 mm), 2 mm) (modulo symmetry; screw + spring also the spring's axial position <= 2 mm)
